subject: Handover: TM-2026-0115 – Ardwell Print Services Limited
body:
Claim reference: TM-2026-0115

Policyholder: Ardwell Print Services Limited
Policy: TM-CP-140882
Class: Commercial property, escape of water
Incident date: 6 July 2026

Status: Open (reserve £74,000; nil paid to date)

Summary
Sprinkler head failure over the finishing area resulted in stock written off at cost price. Business interruption claim intimated with eighteen-month indemnity period. Increased cost of working has been authorised for hired equipment whilst the area is reinstated.

Currently with: Large loss unit

Outstanding
• Reinstatement progress
• Stock valuation confirmation
• Business interruption claim assessment
• Increased cost of working claim quantification

Please advise on next steps.
